Based on my extensive research across multiple web searches, I was unable to locate **complete 2023 top 10 ranking lists** for either metric directly from Our World in Data's published content. Here's what I found:

## Key Limitations:
- **Interactive Dashboards Only**: Our World in Data hosts education spending data primarily within interactive graphers (e.g., `https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/education-spending`) rather than static tables or PDF reports
- **Data Year Discrepancy**: Most accessible visualizations show **2024-2026 data** instead of 2023
- **JavaScript Required**: The interactive tools require browser JavaScript and don't display complete ranking tables in searchable formats

## Partial Information Found:

### Education Spending as Share of Total Government Spending (partial examples):
- **Belarus, Ireland, Georgia**: ~12.2-12.3% (labeled as 2025 data)
- **Andorra, Finland, Belgium, Singapore, Bulgaria, Netherlands**: ~12-12.1% (labeled as 2025 data)

### Education Spending as Share of GDP (partial examples):
- **Kiribati**: ~16.4% (attributed to Visual Capitalist referencing Our World in Data)
- **Tuvalu**: ~12.9% 
- **Sweden**: ~7.3%
- **High-income countries 2023** (TheGlobalEconomy.com, not OWID): New Zealand 5.21%, Kuwait 5.03%, Uruguay 4.76%, Mauritius 4.57%

## How to Access This Data:
To get the actual 2023 top 10 lists you're seeking:

1. **Visit**: [https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/education-spending](https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/education-spending)
2. **Use the filter** to select year **2023** specifically
3. **Look for**:
   - Chart: "Government spending on education as a share of GDP"
   - Chart: "Government spending on education as a share of total spending"

Alternatively, you could consult:
- **UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS)** - SE.XPD.TOTL.GD.ZS indicator
- **World Bank Database** - Education expenditure (% of GDP)
- **OECD Education at a Glance** (for member countries)

Unfortunately, due to how Our World in Data structures its data (interactive rather than static), the complete verified 2023 top 10 rankings aren't publicly available as searchable documents outside of their dashboard interface.
